title: [agent-usage 03/12] Report spend against caps with the exhausted cap and its reset time
body:
**Blocked by:** #1453
**Model tier:** medium

## Context

Model tier rationale: One new read-only tenant route that reuses the gateway's own spend function, with the route-registration hotspots and an isolation test to update, but no schema change.

Each tenant has AI caps in `tenant_ai_budgets` (migration 0070; read with `getCurrentTenantAiBudget` in `backend/packages/data/src/aiGateway/tenantAiBudgetsStore.ts`), a daily and a monthly cap, either of which can be null (no per-tenant cap in that window). A tenant without a row may not spend at all: the gateway refuses every call (`assertWithinBudget` in `backend/packages/ai-gateway/src/gateway.ts`). The existing `GET /api/ai-usage` already returns the caps as `budgets`, but a client cannot learn from it whether the caps are used up, when they reset, or what the gateway currently counts; the gateway's refusal itself is the same for every cause (ADR `docs/adr/2026-10-16-per-tenant-ai-budgets-with-a-global-safety-cap.md`) and its reservations count too.

This issue adds a small summary route, `GET /api/ai-usage/summary`, for screens that need the current spend against the caps (the usage screen and the account profile). Spend comes from `getGatewaySpend` in `aiGatewayCallsStore.ts`, the same function the gateway enforces with, so the number shown is the number that refuses. The Semp status problems in #1871 and the account summary in #1903 build on it.

Decisions: (1) when both windows are exhausted, `exhausted` is `monthly` because it blocks longer. (2) `resetsAt` is set only while a cap is exhausted, else null. (3) Operator-wide safety caps are never reported; a refusal caused only by them leaves `exhausted` null, so they are not revealed. (4) A tenant without a budget row reports `hasBudget` false, `exhausted` null and null caps; a null cap is returned as null, never 0. The existing `budgets` field of `/api/ai-usage` keeps its own different convention and is not changed.

Shared-file ordering: this issue also waits for #1453 because both edit the same registry, manifest, cutover, route matrix or hook files listed in Touches.

## Task

Load `testing` and `io-hardening`.

1. Add `getAiUsageSummary(client)` in a new `backend/packages/data/src/aiGateway/aiUsageSummary.ts`, exported from the data barrel. It reads the tenant's budget row and the tenant time zone (`getSystemTimezone`), calls `getGatewaySpend(client, timezone)`, and returns `{hasBudget, spentTodayUsd, spentMonthUsd, dailyCapUsd, monthlyCapUsd, exhausted, resetsAt}`. `exhausted` is `monthly` when a non-null monthly cap is reached (`spentMonth >= cap`, the gateway's comparison), else `daily` when a non-null daily cap is reached, else null. `resetsAt` is, for `daily`, the next local midnight, for `monthly`, the first instant of the next month, both in the tenant's time zone, as an ISO 8601 string.
2. Add `createAiUsageSummaryRouteHandler(pool)` next to the existing handler in `aiUsageRouteHandler.ts` (thin mapping, status 200).
3. Register it in `backend/packages/data/src/chokePoint/schemaCoreModuleManifest.ts` as a custom route `aiUsageSummary`, `GET /api/ai-usage/summary`, justification `single-consumer-read`.
4. Add the route to `backend/services/semprec-api/src/routeMatrix.ts` (name "ai usage summary", tenancy `tenant`, authenticated), the handler file mapping in `backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/chokePointWriteBoundary.unit.test.ts`, and an exclusion case in `backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/tenantIsolationRoutes.test.ts` (another tenant's spend never appears).
5. Tests in the data package: the figures equal what `getGatewaySpend` returns for the same data, including a `reserved` row; daily and monthly exhaustion with the right `resetsAt` in a non-UTC time zone; a null cap stays null; no row gives `hasBudget` false; reaching only an operator-wide cap leaves `exhausted` null.

## Touches

- backend/packages/data/src/aiGateway/aiUsageSummary.ts (new)
- backend/packages/data/src/aiGateway/aiUsageRouteHandler.ts (new handler factory)
- backend/packages/data/src/chokePoint/schemaCoreModuleManifest.ts (one customRoutes entry)
- backend/packages/data/src/index.ts (new export line)
- backend/services/semprec-api/src/routeMatrix.ts (new route entry)
- backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/chokePointWriteBoundary.unit.test.ts (handler file mapping)
- backend/services/semprec-api/src/__tests__/tenantIsolationRoutes.test.ts (one case)
- backend/packages/data/src/aiGateway/__tests__/aiUsageSummary.test.ts (new)

## Scope

### In scope

- The summary function, its route and the registration and test hotspots above.

### Out of scope

- Showing the problem in Semp status: #1871; refreshing it when the gateway first refuses and when the window resets: #2023 and #2024.
- The profile summary that consumes `spentMonthUsd`: #1903.
- Limits of past months: decided not to be shown; past months show spend only, and only the current limits exist.
- A default cap for new accounts: decided not to exist; a tenant without a budget row stays refused (fail-closed) until an administrator sets its limits when setting up the account.
- Changing the gateway's refusal or its reservations.

## Acceptance criteria

- When today's spend (reservations included) reaches the daily cap, then the summary reports `exhausted` `daily` and `resetsAt` equal to the next midnight in the tenant's time zone, and the next gateway call is refused.
- When the month's spend reaches the monthly cap, then `exhausted` is `monthly` and `resetsAt` is the first of the next month.
- When the tenant has no budget row, then `hasBudget` is false; when a cap is null, then it is null in the response, not 0.
- When only an operator-wide cap is reached, then `exhausted` is null.
- `spentTodayUsd` and `spentMonthUsd` equal the values `getGatewaySpend` returns in the same transaction.
- A user of another tenant never sees this tenant's figures.
